title: Gendered Words and Grant Rates: A Textual Analysis of Disparate Outcomes in the Patent System

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing patent application abstracts using natural language processing and machine learning classifiers (Logistic Regression, DeBERTa, Random Forest) to predict inventor gender from textual characteristics. The study also uses HDBSCAN clustering to evaluate patent rejection rates across male- and female-dominated technological fields, and applies corpus linguistics to examine the gendered connotations of specific terms used in the applications.
